_note: Copy to .superdesign/src/links.json. Render-time link map (lib/sd.tsx): <A href="#hash"> becomes a live draft URL (ids from drafts.json). A link to its own page keeps its #hash when that id exists on the page. Lookup order: id, page, hash, prefix; an id mapped to null keeps the hash on purpose and is never a dead end. mobile.map sends links on mobile pages to the mobile twin. Buttons and forms that navigate call go(useHref('#hash')).
